seo.title: Track an order | Awrea Paris
seo.description: Track your Awrea Paris order without an account, with the order number and email address. The making, the invoice, a return or a size exchange, in one place.

recherche.chapeau: The order number and the email address you used are enough, with no account needed. You can follow the making of your piece step by step, and find the invoice, a return or a size exchange.
recherche.aide: The number appears in the confirmation email and begins with “AW-”. Do you have an account? Your orders are waiting for you in {lien}.

formulaire.erreur: The search did not go through. Please try again.

frise.delai: Your piece is made for you, to order, by French artisans. Allow {delai} for the making.
frise.estimation: The making should be finished between {debut} and {fin}.
frise.estimationJour: The making should be finished on {fin}.
frise.retard: The making is taking a few days longer than planned. The atelier will write to you as soon as your piece is ready.

situations.pending: Payment is not yet confirmed. The making begins as soon as it is.
situations.blocked: The Maison is checking your order before the making begins, and will write to you very soon.
situations.returned: A return is in progress for this order.

commande.retrait: We will write to you to choose the day together.
commande.colisAVenir: The carrier’s tracking link will appear here once the parcel is dispatched.
commande.etiquetteAVenir: The atelier will email you the label within the day.
commande.retourTexte: Until {date}, an unworn piece can come back to the atelier, for a refund or another size. The return slip gives you the atelier’s address; the cost of sending the parcel is yours.

raisons.tombe: The fall does not suit me
raisons.matiere: The material is not what I expected

retour.remboursementNote: To the original payment method, as soon as the piece reaches the atelier
retour.echangeNote: Your piece is made in the new size as soon as the one you send back arrives
retour.engagement: I will send the piece back unworn, with its labels, within {jours} days of delivery.
retour.erreur: The request could not be saved.

confirmation.suite: We will write to you at each step: when your piece goes into the making, when it is ready, then on the day it leaves, with the tracking link.
